meta.notes: The list of agencies a First Sergeant routes to, used as the spine of the toolkit: installation directories and situation cards both key off these ids. Drafted from the maintainer’s brief rather than from a published list of helping agencies, so it stays status=stub until someone checks it against official guidance and against what the installations actually field. Adding, removing, or re-wording an agency is a data edit here; no component names one. mosPages names the MilitaryINSTALLATIONS program page that carries each agency, and is what scripts/import-installations.mjs reads to build a directory. An empty list means Military OneSource does not publish that agency per installation — the crisis agencies mostly fall in that bucket, which is why the worldwide fallback matters. Adding a mapping is a data edit here; the importer names no agency itself. siteLabels and siteExcludeLabels are the same idea for the installations' own websites: scripts/import-base-directories.mjs matches a directory line's label against siteLabels, drops it if any siteExcludeLabels phrase appears, and drops it again if two categories both claim it. Widening or tightening what the importer will accept is a data edit here; the script names no agency itself. military-onesource carries no siteLabels on purpose — it is one worldwide number, taken from national.json, never read off a base page.
